search_performed.note: no code in either repository writes the rgb/<ns>.png + depth/<ns>.png + cam_K.txt layout. save_rgbd.py writes colour JPEG only; logger.py writes raw/meta/model calibration logs; main_rec.py records forklift runs. The recorder that produced these eight sequences is not present.

evidence_found.quote: data/outside/capture* 형식 (cam_K.txt + rgb/{ts}.png + depth/{ts}.png, depth=uint16 mm)
evidence_found.what_it_establishes: a project record stating the stored depth is uint16 millimetres for this exact layout
evidence_found.what_it_does_not_establish: it describes the format a reader was written against, not a writer's contract

evidence_found.quote: task.yaml의 camera intrinsic이 header.txt geo_fx/fy/cx/cy와 일치 (614.18/614.31/329.28/234.53)
evidence_found.what_it_establishes: the day cam_K equals the DOPE baseline RGB header intrinsic, so it is the colour-stream K for the RGB pipeline
evidence_found.what_it_does_not_establish: that the same file is the K the depth was aligned into at capture time

evidence_found.quote: 12개 시퀀스, 약 9,900 frames, intrinsic은 baseline header와 동일 (RealSense D435i)
evidence_found.what_it_establishes: device family is RealSense D435i and the intrinsic matches the RGB baseline

evidence_found.quote: numpy uint16(mm) depth; get_distance returns d/1000.0

evidence_found.what_it_establishes: the project's own capture-side code, when it captures depth, aligns to colour first
evidence_found.what_it_does_not_establish: that this particular file produced these sequences; logger.py writes raw/meta/model, not rgb/ and depth/
